observed_facts: The temporary permission to call iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy was stored, stabilized and accepted by AWS.
The single simulation API call succeeded.
The simulated iam:CreatePolicy action was evaluated as implicitDeny.
The simulated action was not executed.
The temporary permission was removed and the exact baseline was restored.
No persistent or unexpected AWS mutation remained.

technical_interpretation.meaning: implicitDeny indicates that no applicable Allow produced an effective permission for the evaluated action and context; it is not equivalent to an explicit Deny and does not identify a single causal policy layer.

reconciled_conclusions: Authorization 127 successfully validated the safe simulation mechanism.
Authorization 127 did not validate permission to create an IAM policy.
No provisioning gate may infer effective permission from successful simulator invocation alone.
The next gate must simulate the intended bounded provisioning principal, exact action-resource pairs and required context before any mutation is considered.
A passing simulation remains evidence for authorization evaluation only and does not itself authorize provisioning.
